claims.claim: The Spin(9) 144/1008/1152 projector orbits reconstruct as disjoint unions of 9/63/72 orthonormal 16-state bases, with effect weight 1/9, 1/63, 1/72.
claims.evidence: verify_compiler.py reconstructs PGL(2,8) lifts, D+ actions, cosets, full ray unions, per-block orthogonality, and exact projector counts.

claims.claim: The three JW seed moment vectors are (1,0,0,14), (1,4,4,6), and (0,1,7,7), and their finite POVM channel transfers are s_k/binom(9,k) on the complete Clifford basis.
claims.evidence: Direct exact JW monomial moment sums; finite even-sign character cancellation; PGL subset transitivity on k=1..4.

claims.claim: W/sqrt(2) is unitary and intertwines the listed Cl9 models, is not a JW Pauli Clifford, and equals the explicit ancilla-free Clifford+T circuit P Q including global phase.
claims.evidence: Exact SymPy checks of WdagW, all nine gamma intertwining equations, the four-term Pauli witness, the CCZ parity decomposition, and the full 16x16 circuit equality.

claims.claim: For m=2n+1, the finite group D+ semidirect A_m reproduces the Spin Haar canonical measure-and-prepare channel of any seed on every operator grade; for stabilizer seeds it is implemented as a uniformly randomized projective-basis measurement without factorial orbit enumeration.
claims.evidence: Even-sign character orthogonality, A_m k-homogeneity for k<=n, complete Clifford operator basis, Pauli-orbit PVM argument, and exact sampler/gate bounds in FINAL_REPORT.md.

claims.claim: The n+1 stabilizer seeds psi_h have exact integer moments, polynomial preparation/readout circuits, O(n log n) expected permutation-label bits, and O(n^2) CNOT readout bounds.
claims.evidence: Closed moment formula and parity-correct Fisher-Yates proof in FINAL_REPORT.md; exact sampler spot checks m=3,5,6.

claims.claim: For supplied rational transfers, a feasible exact LP over psi_0 through psi_n gives one full-domain canonical EB comparator; no all-n feasibility guarantee for this restricted seed family is proved.
conditions: Rational channel transfers are supplied or independently acquired with an adequate robust margin.
The exact rational LP over the finite seed family psi_0 through psi_n is feasible.
claims.remaining_unknown: The unrestricted all-n continuous-support star inequality remains UNKNOWN. It does not imply feasibility of the restricted finite-seed LP. A stronger finite-family support inequality sufficient for that feasibility fails at Spin(15), but that failure does not establish infeasibility for any supplied legal transfer vector. No transfer-acquisition protocol or q-solver execution was performed. The sibling n=7 r=0 lower-support probes are not a star proof or a channel counterexample.

claims.claim: The Spin(2n+1) psi0 channel differs from the known Spin(2n) matchgate-shadow measurement channel: it retains odd operators and has different coefficients on shared even Majorana grades.
claims.evidence: Wan et al. (2023), Eq. (30) and Sec. 3.4.1; Zhao et al. (2021). No novelty or priority claim is made.
